roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for clinical staff, alongside managing and overseeing all infection control initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about fostering a culture of continuous learning and maintaining a safe, healthy environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description: Join a dynamic skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, that has recently undergone new ownership and is poised for significant growth. We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Marketing Director to lead our outreach efforts and drive census development. This is a unique opportunity to make a substantial impact within a supportive and evolving environment.As Marketing Director, you will be instrumental in building strong community relationships, executing strategic marketing plans, and ensuring consistent census growth. The ideal candidate will be a proactive leader with a strong business development acumen, comfortable with occasional weekend work to meet facility needs. We offer competitive compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate a proven track record of success.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a professional demeanor.
Demonstrated ability to drive business development and achieve census goals.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as required.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and proven track record.

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus. If you are passionate about making a difference in patients' lives and thrive in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.As a PRN Speech Language Pathologist, you will provide essential speech and language therapy services to patients, helping them regain communication and swallowing abilities. This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP looking for flexible scheduling and the chance to contribute to a supportive team dedicated to patient recovery and well-being.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This Per Diem (PRN) opportunity allows for flexibility while providing essential therapy services to patients in a supportive environment. If you are passionate about helping individuals regain their independence and improve their quality of life, we encourage you to apply.

In this role, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs for patients. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure comprehensive care, utilizing your expertise to facilitate patient recovery and functional improvement. This is an excellent opportunity for a PT looking for flexible scheduling.

Join a team committed to clinical excellence and patient-centered care. We are looking for a professional who can contribute positively to our dynamic therapy department.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work flexible Per Diem (PRN) shifts

description:
Are you a dedicated Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA), Occupational Therapist (OT), or Speech Therapist (ST) seeking a rewarding opportunity? A premier skilled nursing facility in Ocala, FL, is actively seeking talented rehabilitation professionals to join their compassionate team. This is an excellent chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment.

We are looking for both full-time and part-time professionals to provide high-quality therapy services. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary team, contributing to individualized care plans and helping patients achieve their rehabilitation goals. This facility values its staff and offers competitive compensation for your expertise.

If you are passionate about rehabilitation and ready to contribute to a patient-centered care model, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and dedicated to fostering a positive and healing atmosphere for all residents.
requirements: Current state licensure as a COTA, PTA, OT, or ST in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: For COTA/PTA roles, full-time compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00 per hour. For full-time and part-time OT/ST roles, compensation ranges from $40.00 - $46.00 per hour.
